This contract-test report describes a controlled engineering workflow trial. The team measured baseline completion time, review time, defect discovery, and the number of changes returned for revision. The result is deliberately labeled as fixture evidence and makes no real-world claim. It exists to test whether exact passages remain traceable through selection, briefing, drafting, and review. The report also states that one team and one task family cannot establish general productivity effects. Review burden and failure recovery should be evaluated separately from the speed of producing a first draft.
